violations.description: General employee practices. — --Employee * failed to maintain a high degree of personal cleanliness or observe proper hygienic practices. - Cigarette ashes found in the hand washing sink. Half smoked cigarette found on the food prep table. Dentures found on the food prep table.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. - Wiping clothes were not stored in sanitizer solution.

Thawing potentially hazardous food. — --Potentially hazardous food * was not tawed in an approved manner. - Frozen lunch meat was set out on the prep sink to thaw. Meat should be thawed in the refrigerator or in a water bath with water agitation.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface * was not cleaned adequately. - Microwave dirty - clean in place equipment doors and handles as well as cabinet faces dirty.--Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. - Vent hood filters and screen dirty.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)* were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. - Floor and walls in the kitchen dirty.
Contaminated food disposition. — --Food * from an unapproved source was not discarded as required. - Expired milk (19 FEB 2026) found in the refrigerator.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface * was not cleaned as frequently as required. - clean in place equipment cabinets, doors, handles and other pieces of equipment in the kitchen are dirty and greasy.

Mechanical cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Sanitize solution for mechanical warewashing machine was not maintained at the proper concentration * . - Sanitizer for dishwasher was empty.--Warewash machine was not maintained and/or operated as required. - Dishwasher not being maintained and checked frequently for sanitizer concentration.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)* were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. - Walls and floors in the kitchen dirty and caked with grease.
